reason: The paragraph number 21 is printed as 'Z 1.' -- a mechanical mis-keying of the digit 2 as the adjacent letter Z, splitting the number in two. It is not a reading: no paragraph in this corpus is numbered with a letter, and the value is fixed by its neighbours rather than chosen. Filed as a source defect rather than handled in the parser because tolerating 'Z 1.' as a paragraph number would make the numbered-paragraph detector accept arbitrary letter-digit debris across ~450 documents to repair one page.
